remarks: Welcome to 511 Roxbury Rd. Nestled in the highly desirable Westover neighborhood, this beautiful single-family home offers the perfect blend of comfort, privacy, and functionality. Step into a welcoming entry foyer that opens to a bright living room with beautiful hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace, and sliding doors leading to a sun-filled family room. The formal dining room flows effortlessly into the oversized eat-in kitchen, featuring Silestone countertops, built-in seating, and plenty of space for gathering and entertaining.  Just off the kitchen, a warm and inviting den with a gas stove and charming bay window provides additional living space with convenient access to the driveway. A second powder room, laundry area, and attached two-car garage add everyday convenience.  As we continue, the spacious primary suite features a walk-in closet, two additional closets, and a beautifully remodeled en-suite bathroom. Three additional generously sized bedrooms and an updated full bathroom complete the home.  Outside, enjoy a spectacular private backyard surrounded by mature landscaping and bordered by Water Company property for added privacy, perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying outdoor activities. Conveniently located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, schools, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities, this home offers both tranquility and accessibility in one of the area's most sought-after neighborhoods.
